# NAutomation Labs

> NAutomation Labs is an AI agency and AI product studio in India building custom AI software for manufacturing, logistics, procurement, warehouses, inventory, maintenance, quality, oil & gas services, EPC and other complex operational workflows.

## Primary capabilities
- Custom AI software and AI product development
- Industrial AI and manufacturing AI solutions
- AI automation for document-heavy and cross-functional workflows
- Production planning and capacity control
- Predictive maintenance and reliability intelligence
- Warehouse and inventory control systems
- Procurement and RFQ intelligence
- Quality, NCR and CAPA workflows
- Logistics and supply-chain exception control
- Industrial document intelligence
- AI agents and retrieval-grounded systems
- Voice agents through decibyl

## Positioning
NAutomation Labs starts with a high-value operating workflow rather than a generic AI tool. The team maps the current process, establishes a measurable baseline, builds a focused production pilot, and expands into connected workflows after proving operating value.
